name: decode a raster image and extract pixel data in c
definition: Read a PNG image, decode it, and obtain the grayscale pixel matrix the classifier consumes.
failure_mode: Failed decode or wrong normalization shifts predictions.

name: detect takeoff and landing frame events of a running athlete in a monocular video
definition: Analyze a video of a single jump to identify the frame where the subject leaves the ground and the frame where they land, given a stationary camera and fixed scene.
failure_mode: Detected frames fall outside the accepted range on hidden videos

name: diagnose and repair an outbound network fetch and confirm end-to-end retrieval of the remote page content
definition: diagnose and repair an outbound network fetch and confirm end-to-end retrieval of the remote page content
failure_mode: a firewall/route/override yields a proxy error page that fails the content-match check

name: drive the emulated program to completion of rendering
definition: execute a large render loop under simulation so the first frame is produced and saved before ending
failure_mode: a mis-modeled register mode or loop bug prevents frame completion
